newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Candle razes Bali's oldest Protestant church.
newsitem.headline: Candle razes Bali's oldest Protestant church.

text.p: A fire caused by a burning candle razed the oldest Protestant Christian church on Indonesia's holiday island of Bali on Christmas Day, the official Antara news agency reported on Thursday.
No casualties were reported. Church authorities estimated the cost of the damage to the church, built at Buduk on the predominantly-Hindu island in 1931, at 500 million rupiah ($212,000).
